S01: At dawn, before the gates of shining Camelot, a lone rider arrived on a white horse.
S02: It was said that he was the son of the famed Lancelot.
S03: On the throne awaited King Arthur.
S04: In the hall stood the great Round Table, filled with knights.
S05: King Arthur: "Sit with us at the Round Table."
S06: All eyes turned to one empty, fateful seat.
S07: The prophecy said: that seat is reserved for the noblest and most honorable alone.
S08: Galahad stepped toward that seat without fear.
S10: He held his breath — all knew that the unworthy had died upon that seat.
S11: But Galahad remained hale and alive, to everyone's wonder.
S12: Then, before him, a radiant chalice appeared.
S13: It was the Holy Grail — the cup that granted immortality to whoever drank from it.
S14: When the chalice vanished, Galahad swore he would set out to find it.
S16: Days on the road through ancient forests and open fields.
S17: He crossed rivers and mountain lands, ever onward.
S18: He spent his nights by the fire, alone with his vow.
S19: The road led him ever higher, through wind and mist.
S20: Finally, before him out of the mist rose the castle of Corbenic.
S21: The gate was heavy, and the courtyard silent.
S22: Inside reigned half-darkness; only torches flickered.
S23: Galahad walked the corridors, driven by some inner force.
S24: At last he reached the king's chamber.
S25: On the bed lay the old King Pelles, pale and helpless.
S26: No healer had been able to find a cure for a long time.
S27: His skin was like wax, his eyes closed.
S29: Before him lay his grandfather, the king of Corbenic.
S30: And as he drew near, his hands began to glow.
S31: In his palms appeared the Holy Grail.
S32: Galahad raised the chalice, and the light spread through the chamber.
S34: He touched the cup to the old man's lips.
S35: King Pelles drank one sip of the miraculous water.
S36: And in that very moment, color began to return to his face.
S37: The light filled the whole castle.
S38: The old man opened his eyes, clear and full of life.
S39: King Pelles rose from the bed, strong as he once was.
S40: The chamber was no longer dark — it became a house of light.
S43: And over all the land, peace shone forth.
S44: Galahad gazed toward the horizon, at peace.
S46: Thus Galahad brought peace to the world and saved Corbenic from suffering.
